note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a BAH 9, Schedule 2-3; A06b BAH 9, Schedule 2-3; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 7 years' residence (the 12 months before the application and 6 of the 9 years before them; the dataset's own count is 6); the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Bahamas, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in the Bahamas for 12 months immediately prior to the application, and was either resident in the country, in the service of the government, or had partly such residence and partly such service for 6 out of 9 years prior to the 12-month period and intent to make the Bahamas his/her permanent home (either by residence or government service). ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... n.a.
